builder.save.title: Save room
builder.save.what: Saves the room layout and its picture placements.
limits: Desktop builders only.

builder.playtest.title: Playtest room
builder.playtest.what: Tries your current draft in the game.
builder.playtest.how: Press Tab to play. Press Tab again to return.

builder.map.title: Map
builder.map.what: Shows where rooms sit and how they line up.
builder.map.how: Press Map or F3 to open it.

builder.undo.title: Undo and Redo
builder.undo.what: Takes back a room edit or puts it back.
builder.undo.how: Press Ctrl+Z to undo. Press Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo.

studio.library.title: The asset library
studio.library.what: Holds searchable copies of project pictures, sounds, and source files.
studio.library.how: Open Library in F2. Run node tools/asset_library.mjs from the repo root to rebuild its list and copies.
limits: The model bank and inbox are listed only. The exported game does not carry the library copies.

builder.close.title: Close builders
builder.close.how: Press Close or Esc. If asked, save, keep editing, or discard the drafts.

builder.select.title: Select objects
builder.select.what: Picks one object or a box of objects.
builder.select.how: Press V and click an object. Shift+drag draws a box. Drag the box or use arrow keys to move it.
limits: The box includes pictures whose top-left corners are inside. A move that would lose contents is refused.

builder.place.title: Place
builder.place.how: Press B or pick an item, then click the room.

builder.move.title: Move
builder.move.how: Press M and drag the object to a new spot.

builder.erase.title: Erase
builder.erase.what: Removes a room symbol or picture.
builder.erase.how: Press E and click the object to remove.

builder.zone.title: Spread
builder.zone.what: Draws a zone to fill with selected enemies or traps.
builder.zone.how: Press S and drag a box, pick types, then press Apply Spread.
limits: Only places types where they fit. Keeps existing objects.

builder.start.title: Play from here
builder.start.what: Changes where the next playtest starts.
builder.start.how: Press P, then click the starting spot.

builder.grid.title: Grid
builder.grid.how: Turn Grid on to see where pieces line up.

builder.collision.title: Collision
builder.collision.what: Shows where walls and platforms block movement.
builder.collision.how: Turn Collision on while checking a room.

builder.tabs.title: Palette groups
builder.tabs.what: Changes the kinds of objects shown in the palette.
builder.tabs.how: Open the menu and pick a group. Right-click the menu for help on that group.

builder.palette.title: Palette items
builder.palette.what: Shows the objects you can place from one group.
builder.palette.how: Click an item and then click the room. Right-click a symbol to learn what it does.

builder.asset_folder.title: Asset Folder
builder.asset_folder.how: Add your PNG files under tiles, props, or backdrops. Then press Refresh.

builder.refresh.title: Refresh
builder.refresh.how: Press Refresh after adding or changing a PNG.

builder.plane.title: Behind, Solid, In Front
builder.plane.what: Sets where the next picture draws and whether it blocks movement.
builder.plane.how: Choose Behind for scenery, Solid for collision, or In Front to cover moving objects.
limits: Solid pictures stay on the room grid. Existing room symbols keep their collision.

builder.count.title: Spread count
builder.count.what: Sets how many selected enemies or traps to try to place.
limits: You may get fewer if the area has too few spots.

builder.apply_spread.title: Apply Spread
builder.apply_spread.what: Fills the drawn zone with picked enemies or traps.
builder.apply_spread.how: Select one or more types, drag a zone in Spread mode, then press Apply Spread.

builder.zoom_out.title: Zoom out
builder.zoom_out.how: Press − or roll the wheel down over the room.

builder.zoom_in.title: Zoom in
builder.zoom_in.what: Makes room objects larger on screen.
builder.zoom_in.how: Press + or roll the wheel up over the room.

builder.fit.title: Fit room
builder.fit.how: Press Fit or F. Hold Space and drag to pan, or use arrows when no box is selected.

builder.delete.title: Delete selection
builder.delete.what: Clears the selected object or box.
builder.delete.how: Press Delete or use the Delete button.

builder.flip.title: Flip picture
builder.flip.what: Mirrors a selected picture left to right.
builder.flip.how: Pick a picture and press Flip.

builder.copy.title: Copy box
builder.copy.how: Select a box with Shift+drag and press Ctrl+C.

builder.cut.title: Cut box
builder.cut.what: Copies and removes the box contents.
builder.cut.how: Select a box and press Ctrl+X.

builder.paste.title: Paste box
builder.paste.what: Adds the copied contents to the room.
builder.paste.how: Point at a tile and press Ctrl+V.
limits: Pieces over the room edge are clipped. The builder tells you when this happens.

builder.duplicate.title: Duplicate box
builder.duplicate.what: Makes another copy of the box contents.
builder.duplicate.how: Select a box and press Ctrl+D.

builder.rotate.title: Rotate
builder.rotate.how: Press R or Rotate to turn it 15° around its top-left corner.
limits: Tiles and solid pictures cannot turn.

builder.shrink.title: Shrink picture
builder.shrink.what: Makes a selected decorative picture smaller.
builder.shrink.how: Press [ or − Size to shrink it by 0.25×.
limits: The smallest size is 0.25×. Tiles and solid pictures keep their size.

builder.grow.title: Grow picture
builder.grow.what: Makes a selected decorative picture larger.
builder.grow.how: Press ] or + Size to grow it by 0.25×.
limits: The largest size is 4×. Tiles and solid pictures keep their size.

builder.free.title: Free placement
builder.free.what: Lets you position decorative pictures between snap points.
builder.free.how: Turn on Free and place or drag a decorative picture.
limits: Tiles and solid pictures still snap to the room grid.

builder.width.title: Room width
builder.width.what: Sets the physical width in 16-pixel tiles.
builder.width.how: Enter the width and press Apply.
limits: Shrinking removes cells on the right. The minimum is four tiles.

builder.height.title: Room height
builder.height.what: Sets the physical height in 16-pixel tiles.
builder.height.how: Enter the height and press Apply.
limits: Shrinking removes cells at the bottom. The minimum is four tiles.

builder.resize.title: Apply room size
builder.resize.how: Set the width and height in tiles, then press Apply.
limits: Shrinking trims the right or bottom. Undo can restore the trimmed cells.

builder.options.title: Playtest Options
builder.options.how: Open the menu for Show hitboxes, Invincible, or Half speed.

builder.hitboxes.title: Show hitboxes
builder.hitboxes.what: Draws the areas that deal or receive hits.

builder.invincible.title: Invincible
builder.invincible.what: Keeps the player from taking damage in playtests.

builder.half_speed.title: Half speed
builder.half_speed.what: Runs the game more slowly during the test.

builder.check.title: Check Reachability
builder.check.what: Checks routes and spots that may be blocked.
builder.check.how: Press Check Reachability, then click an issue to see where it is.

builder.issue.title: Room issue
builder.issue.what: Points out a possible problem in the room.
builder.issue.how: Click the issue to bring its location into view.

library.search.title: Search assets
library.search.what: Finds project assets by name, category, or tag.
library.search.how: Type one or more words, such as stone tile.

library.categories.title: Asset categories
library.categories.what: Narrows the library by asset type.
library.categories.how: Choose a group in the menu. Right-click for help on that group.

library.results.title: Search results
library.results.what: Shows the matches and whether they can be used in a room.
library.results.how: Pick a result to see its details. Double-click a placeable picture to use it.

library.asset_help.title: Asset help
library.asset_help.what: Explains what a library item is and how it can be used.

library.use.title: Use this picture
library.use.what: Copies a supported PNG into the room builder palette.
library.use.how: Pick a placeable result, press Use this picture, then click the room.
limits: Sounds, source files and JPG pictures cannot be placed.

map.map.title: Map builder
map.map.what: Shows room layouts on one era sheet at a time.
map.map.how: Press F3 or Builders to open it. Right-click a control or use its ? for help.

map.edit.title: Edit Room
map.edit.what: Opens the selected room in the room builder.
map.edit.how: Pick a room then press Edit Room or Enter.

map.play.title: Play Here
map.play.what: Starts a playtest in the selected room.
map.play.how: Pick a room then press Play Here or T. Press Tab to return.

map.undo.title: Undo map edit
map.undo.what: Takes back the last map change.

map.redo.title: Redo map edit
map.redo.what: Restores a map edit you took back.

map.save.title: Save Map
map.save.what: Writes map positions and room footprints.

map.close.title: Close builders
map.close.what: Closes the map and room workspaces.
map.close.how: Press Close or Esc. Choose what to do if a draft is unsaved.

map.search.title: Find a room
map.search.what: Filters the room list on this era sheet.
map.search.how: Type a room name or code.

map.rooms.title: Room thumbnails
map.rooms.what: Show a small picture of the terrain in each room.
map.rooms.how: Click a thumbnail to select that room. The map brings it into view.

map.sheet.before.title: Before sheet
limits: Edit each room on its own era sheet.

map.sheet.after.title: After sheet
limits: Edit each room on its own era sheet.

map.sheet.restored.title: Restored sheet
limits: Edit each room on its own era sheet.

map.zoom_out.title: Zoom map out
map.zoom_out.how: Press − or roll the wheel down. Drag with the middle mouse, right mouse or Space held to pan.

map.zoom_in.title: Zoom map in
map.zoom_in.how: Press + or roll the wheel up. Arrow keys pan the map.

map.fit.title: Fit map
map.fit.what: Shows all rooms on the active map sheet.

map.center.title: Center room
map.center.what: Moves the selected room into the center of the view.
map.center.how: Pick a room, then press Center.

map.x.title: Map X
map.x.what: Sets the left edge of the selected room on the map.
map.x.how: Enter a cell number, drag the room, or press Alt+left or right.
limits: Positions start at 0.

map.y.title: Map Y
map.y.what: Sets the top edge of the selected room on the map.
map.y.how: Enter a cell number, drag the room, or press Alt+up or down.
limits: Positions start at 0.

map.width.title: Map width
map.width.what: Changes how many map cells wide the room appears.
map.width.how: Enter a width, drag the resize handle or press Shift+left or right.
limits: The minimum is one map cell. This does not resize the physical room.

map.height.title: Map height
map.height.what: Changes how many map cells tall the room appears.
map.height.how: Enter a height, drag the resize handle or press Shift+up or down.
limits: The minimum is one map cell. This does not resize the physical room.

map.issue.title: Map issue
map.issue.what: Points out a possible problem such as a disconnected room.
map.issue.how: Click the issue to show its location and read the details.

map.overlap_room.title: Choose overlapping room
map.overlap_room.what: Picks one of the rooms at the clicked spot.
map.overlap_room.how: Click its name in the list.

map.overlap_cancel.title: Cancel overlap list
map.overlap_cancel.what: Closes the list and keeps your current room selected.

tuning.feel.title: Feel
tuning.feel.what: Shows the main controls for the game's feel.
tuning.feel.how: Press F1, then FEEL. Drag a slider to try a value.

tuning.weapons.title: Weapons
tuning.weapons.what: Shows the weapon picker and weapon settings.
tuning.weapons.how: Press F1, then WEAPONS. Use < or > to try a weapon.

tuning.sounds.title: Sounds
tuning.sounds.what: Shows the music and sound effect choices.
tuning.sounds.how: Press F1, then SOUNDS. Use < or > to preview a choice.

tuning.part.title: Extra tuning page
tuning.part.what: Groups related game settings on one page.
tuning.part.how: Choose a tab, then drag a slider. Press ? for that setting's range and values.

tuning.save.title: Save tuning
tuning.save.what: Keeps your changes to supported tuning and sound settings.
tuning.save.how: Press Save at the bottom of F1.

tuning.reset.title: Reset tuning
tuning.reset.what: Restores the last saved tuning and sound choices.
tuning.reset.how: Press Reset at the bottom of F1.

studio.search.title: Studio help
studio.search.what: Finds help by tool, key, or activity and shows the library path.
studio.search.how: Click Studio, type what you want to do, then open a result.

studio.notes.title: Screenshot notes
studio.notes.what: Records feedback on a frozen frame.
studio.notes.how: Press F4. Type a note, drag to mark an area, and press Enter to save. Right-click removes the last box. Esc cancels.

studio.stop_test.title: Stop Playtest
studio.stop_test.what: Returns to the builder and its current draft.
studio.stop_test.how: Press Tab, Esc, F2, or F3 while playing a builder test.

palette.terrain.title: Terrain
palette.terrain.what: Walls, ledges, bars, and openings that shape the room.
palette.terrain.how: Pick Terrain and place symbols on the 16-pixel grid.

palette.enemies.title: Enemies
palette.enemies.what: Enemy spawn positions inside a room.
palette.enemies.how: Pick Enemies, then place one or use Spread.

palette.hazards.title: Traps
palette.hazards.how: Pick Traps, then place one or use Spread where there is support.

palette.spots.title: Room Markers
palette.spots.what: Starts, doors, terminals and other room points.
palette.spots.how: Pick Room Markers. Place the marker that the room needs.

palette.tiles.title: PNG Tiles
palette.tiles.what: Pictures placed on the 16-pixel room grid.
palette.tiles.how: Pick PNG Tiles and choose a layer. Use Solid to add collision to empty cells.

palette.props.title: PNG Props
palette.props.what: Decorative pictures such as furniture or lamps.
palette.props.how: Pick PNG Props, choose Behind or In Front, then place the picture.

palette.backdrops.title: Backdrop
palette.backdrops.what: A picture used as the room background.
palette.backdrops.how: Pick Backdrop and choose a picture to use instead of the default wall.

catalog.3d.title: 3D model bank
catalog.3d.how: Search to see the original path.
limits: Models are listed only and cannot be placed.

catalog.audio.title: Audio
catalog.audio.what: Music and sound effects from the project.
catalog.audio.how: Search by a cue name or group. Use F1 SOUNDS to try configured choices.
limits: Audio cannot be placed as a room picture.

catalog.bosses.title: Bosses
catalog.bosses.what: Pictures and source files for bosses.
catalog.bosses.how: Search by boss name to find reference art.

catalog.characters.title: Characters
catalog.characters.what: Pandora and hero pictures and sources.
catalog.characters.how: Search by character or movement name.

catalog.concepts.title: Concept art
catalog.concepts.how: Search for a subject or file name to find its source.

catalog.enemies.title: Enemies
catalog.enemies.what: Enemy pictures at their original scales.
catalog.enemies.how: Search by enemy name. Use the F2 Enemies palette to place a spawn.

catalog.environment.title: Environment
catalog.environment.how: Search by theme or object, then use a placeable PNG in F2.

catalog.fx.title: Effects
catalog.fx.what: Effect art, such as sparks and spell pictures.
catalog.fx.how: Search by effect name to preview a picture.

catalog.inbox.title: Inbox
catalog.inbox.how: Search to find a file and its original path.
limits: Files are listed only and cannot be placed.

catalog.items.title: Items
catalog.items.what: Pictures for relics and other items.
catalog.items.how: Search by item name. If a PNG is placeable, you can use it as a picture.

catalog.other.title: Other assets
catalog.other.what: Files outside the named library groups.
catalog.other.how: Search by filename and check each result's details.

catalog.palettes.title: Color palettes
catalog.palettes.how: Search by palette name to find the original.

catalog.root-assets.title: Shared assets
catalog.root-assets.what: Files held in the repo's shared asset folders.
catalog.root-assets.how: Search for the filename or tag and check the original path.

catalog.source.title: Source and reference files
catalog.source.what: Original artwork, previews, and other working files.
catalog.source.how: Search by name to find the source path.

catalog.weapon.title: Weapon art
catalog.weapon.what: Pictures and source files for weapons.
catalog.weapon.how: Search by weapon name. Use F1 WEAPONS to try the game's weapon choices.

library.recent.title: Recent pictures
library.recent.what: Shows pictures used from the library in this game session.
library.recent.how: Turn on Recent beside the category menu. The last picture you used appears first.
